description: This file contains functions and logic for transforming and replacing quantized operators with standard operators within a Torch FX GraphModule, including handling of quantization parameters, unpacking ScriptObjects, and managing quantization schemes.

methods.name: int_to_valid_dtype
methods.description: Converts an integer or dtype to a valid torch.dtype, handling specific cases for quantized types.

methods.name: fx_enum_to_dtype
methods.description: Converts an enum value to a torch.fx.Node representing the dtype.

methods.name: insert_quantized_node
methods.description: Inserts a quantize_per_tensor node into the FX graph.

methods.name: get_dequantized
methods.description: Returns a dequantized tensor based on the quantization scheme.

methods.name: insert_dequantized_node
methods.description: Inserts a dequantize node into the FX graph based on the quantization scheme.

methods.name: get_qmin_qmax
methods.description: Calculates qmin and qmax for a given dtype.

methods.name: insert_qmin_qmax_node
methods.description: Inserts nodes to compute qmin and qmax into the FX graph.

methods.name: get_script_object
methods.description: Retrieves a ScriptObject from a get_attr node in the FX graph.

methods.name: insert_weight_and_bias_get_attr_node_from_get_attr_to_scriptobject
methods.description: Inlines weight and bias tensors from a ScriptObject into the FX graph.

methods.name: insert_weight_and_bias_get_attr_node_from_get_attr_to_qtensor
methods.description: Gets weight and bias tensors from a get_attr node and converts them to quantized tensors.

methods.name: insert_weight_and_bias_get_attr_node
methods.description: Inserts weight and bias tensors as attributes into the FX graph.

methods.name: get_tensor_from_qtensor
methods.description: Converts a quantized tensor to a dequantized tensor if needed.

methods.name: insert_fused_activation_node
methods.description: Inserts a fused activation (ReLU) node if applicable.

methods.name: _conv1d_op_with_squeeze
methods.description: Emulates conv1d using conv2d with squeeze and unsqueeze.

methods.name: _transform_conv_with_packedparam
methods.description: Transforms convolution with packed parameters into a standard call.

methods.name: _transform_linear_with_packedparam
methods.description: Transforms linear with packed parameters into a standard call.

methods.name: _transform_op_where_last_two_arguments_are_scale_and_zero_point
methods.description: Transforms operations where last two args are scale and zero point.

methods.name: _transform_scalar_arithmetic
methods.description: Transforms scalar arithmetic operations.

methods.name: _transform_prepacked_op
methods.description: Transforms prepacked operators into standard calls.

methods.name: _transform_batch_norm
methods.description: Transforms batch normalization into a standard call.

methods.name: fx_transform_quantized_op_to_standard_op
methods.description: Transforms a quantized operator node into a standard operator node.

methods.name: replace_quantized_ops_with_standard_ops
methods.description: Main function to replace all legacy quantized ops with standard ops in a FX GraphModule.
